title: Verkehrsunfall und Festnahme nach Flucht vor Verkehrskontrolle – zwei Polizisten verletzt

extraction.summaryEn: A 15-year-old driver fled a traffic check at high speed, then braked sharply at Uhlandstraße/Steinplatz, causing a collision with a police car. Two officers were slightly injured and the driver was arrested; he was allegedly under the influence of drugs and had no valid licence.
